⚡Welcome to +1 Speed Squishy Ball Escape

How to Play:
🔴 Stick to walls and roll like a squishy bal!
👟 Every Roll makes you faster!
🏆 Complete obstacles to get wins
💪 Unlock new upgrades
♻️ Rebirth to push your limits

🌍BECOME THE FASTEST IN THE SERVER!

🔥Join the GROUP and LIKE the game for free rewards!

🎧 ASMR vibes included!
Smooth and squishy movement, addictive, satisfying soft-body physics, keycaps for a perfect mix of speed & chill!
